title: Barry Sacramento · Interior 2.5D Fly-Through
provenance: Clean Sacramento construction corridor rendered once as the continuous interior plate, plus generated photographic cutouts derived from the user-approved reference composition: two independent businessmen, two synchronized foot-anchored floor shadows, foreground fog and residual haze. Figures enter and exit as separate cutout layers; no duplicated rectangular corridor slices are used.

motion.effect: photographic 2.5D parallax fly-through / foreground fog occlusion / downward camera glide
motion.principle: continuous forward/downward camera travel; one clean corridor plate remains spatially coherent; foreground fog fully occludes the lens before clearing downward; people and shadows remain independent depth planes
motion.masterTransition: foreground construction dust/fog rises across the lens, vertical whoosh smear hides the substitution, then the same occluder sweeps downward while the already-moving interior resolves
